spine: Casella & Berger, Statistical Inference, 2nd ed. (grade A, id f9dc4d1d4c), all 12 chapters with proofs
rules: Every chapter course starts with a pretest (concept / calculation / proof per section) and ends with a chapter check.
A lesson = block 1 reading (~7 pp, reading guide) + block 2 lesson page with one proof task.
